title: Top 8 Schools in Florida With the Most Fights (All Miami-Dade)
igCaption:
The top 8 schools in Florida for fights were ALL in Miami-Dade 😳🥊 (2013–14 school year)

Did your school make the list? Be honest 👇

Data: Florida DOE school incident reports, via Miami New Times. Satire — the kids are grown now 😂

#miami #miamidade #southflorida #florida #schoolfights #cutlerbay #homestead #miamigardens #wynwood #brownsville #throwback #middleschool #highschool

scenes.text: Top eight schools in Florida with the most fights? All Miami-Dade. And number one had more fights than school days.
scenes.note: 2013–14 school year · FL DOE data via Miami New Times

scenes.text: Number eight, South Dade High. A hundred nineteen fights. That's more than the Dolphins have playoff wins in my lifetime.
scenes.caption: Number eight, South Dade High. 119 fights. That's more than the Dolphins have playoff wins in my lifetime.

scenes.text: Number seven, Southridge. A hundred twenty-three. There, the bell doesn't mean class is over. It means round two.
scenes.caption: Number seven, Southridge. 123. There, the bell doesn't mean class is over. It means round two.

scenes.text: Number six, José de Diego Middle in Wynwood. A hundred twenty-three. Tourists pay twenty bucks to see the walls. This show was free.
scenes.caption: Number six, José de Diego Middle in Wynwood. 123. Tourists pay $20 to see the walls. This show was free.

scenes.text: Number five, Brownsville Middle. A hundred twenty-seven. Can't find Canada on a map, but they know exactly which hallway has no cameras.
scenes.caption: Number five, Brownsville Middle. 127. Can't find Canada on a map, but they know exactly which hallway has no cameras.

scenes.text: Number four is an elementary school. Toussaint L'Ouverture. A hundred twenty-seven fights. They still need help opening juice boxes. It gets worse.
scenes.caption: Number four is an ELEMENTARY school. Toussaint L'Ouverture. 127 fights. They still need help opening juice boxes. It gets worse.

scenes.text: Number three, North Dade Middle. A hundred thirty-two. That's almost every school day. Showing up counted as P.E.
scenes.caption: Number three, North Dade Middle. 132. That's almost every school day. Showing up counted as P.E.

scenes.text: Number two, Mandarin Lakes K through eight. A hundred thirty-seven. K through eight. Somewhere in there, a kindergartner has a record.
scenes.caption: Number two, Mandarin Lakes K-8. 137. K through 8. Somewhere in there, a kindergartner has a record.

scenes.text: And number one... Cutler Bay Middle. A hundred eighty-eight fights. The school year is a hundred eighty days. They did overtime.
scenes.caption: And number one... Cutler Bay Middle. 188 fights. The school year is 180 days. They did overtime.

scenes.text: Did your school make the list? Comment it. Cutler Bay, we know.
